schedule_18.scope: Pure actual helper; no browser storage, HTTP or live service

counting_note: Pure Node checks are also exercised inside selected Python cases and are reported separately, not added to the 348 Python tests; repeats add no distinct coverage. Inherited 224 calendar parity cases are within one Python test.

historical_release_assertions.status: All four fail on both untouched verified UI20 and initial UI21; no test weakening or claim that these passed.

preliminary_attempts_excluded: Initial handover run: 257 passed / 4 failed; not added to the final selected 257.
Initial responsive browser check exposed 768px header overflow after adding Help; wrapping/flex sizing corrected, later final viewports pass.
Initial UI21 about:blank fixture made the pre-existing generic URL navigation guard throw. Fixture now sets an inert base href; no application code was changed for this fixture issue.
Attempted loopback navigation was blocked by Chromium policy before assertions; not counted as live/browser-navigation acceptance.
Initial broad source assertion found create Help catalogue mismatch; reproduced byte-identically on UI20 and left outside the two reviewed articles.
limitations: No live GitHub fetch/push, Render deployment, current database or credential changes.
Not a full product suite. Four historical release assertions fail on untouched UI20 as well as this source; explicitly deselected in the final selection and never counted as passes.

Chromium used shipped UI assets, actual in-process fictional TestClient APIs, injected transport and in-memory persistence; not actual hosted HTTPS, LAN, durable browser storage or service-worker lifecycle acceptance.

Help-link activation was exercised with navigation suppressed by the fixture; real local navigation was blocked by browser policy (ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR). No browser policy was weakened, and real separate-tab navigation is not accepted here.
No real phone/Windows, full accessibility, Docker, production security/isolation/load or off-host recovery acceptance. PowerShell checker not run on Windows.
New day counters are overlapping permission-scoped snapshots, not crew-roster or live completion totals. Saved-draft panel does not inventory unsaved browser text.
UI20 time-basis and calendar semantics unchanged: device-calendar Today and wall-clock schedules, no timezone/DST conversion.
Inherited create Help search-index text discrepancy remains unchanged and is recorded for the separate create-article review.
persistent_change: None introduced. Existing explicit UI20 forms/writers and their record formats remain unchanged; the new projections and navigation do not save or create records.
public_entry_user_feedback: User confirmed G01 public guest entry works after correcting its role; source and settings preserved.
